entities.name: Livio
entities.description: A knight from Fiora who renounced his noble family to defend the common folk.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: A plane of political games, deception and treachery.

entities.name: Marchesa
entities.description: The queen who views Livio as an amusing wild card and now wants to talk with him.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: The High City where Livio defeats cutthroats.

entities.name: Livio's father
entities.description: A noble who ordered a village destroyed to spite another noble.

events.summary: Livio watched his father order a village destroyed to spite another noble, then tore off the family crest and renounced his family name and title.
events.quote: He ripped the family crest off his doublet

events.summary: Livio dispatched some of the queen's men who were shaking down a local merchant, so Marchesa wants a talk.
events.quote: he dispatched some of the queen's men who were shaking down a local merchant

relations.note: Livio is the only heir to his father's noble house but renounced it.
relations.quote: The only heir to a noble house

relations.note: She views him as an amusing wild card and now wants a talk.
relations.quote: Now, Marchesa thinks she and Livio should have a little talk.
